title: Dummy Entities
description: Entity Dummys allow you to summon a dummy entity that will show you how much dmg you do per hit!
body:
# Dummy Entites!

**dummy entities allow you to summon a dummy with any entity type! and hit it and test the dmg your weapon does!**

**why you should download this entity dummy datapack?**

you should download this cuz its good and has a COOL text animation on hit!
not only that its optimize and uses 1 entity per dummy (2 for the hit mark thing)

![gif of hit mark](https://i.imgur.com/W6WrmVI.gif)


**allows you to summon a dummy entity with the following command**
```
/function dummy:summon {Entity:TYPE}
```

replace the type with the entity name (like: pig,cow,zombie)
